# catalyst_filestore_file (Resource)

Deprecated: Zoho has announced File Store sunset on 31 October 2026; use Stratus for new storage. See the [vendor announcement](https://docs.catalyst.zoho.com/en/announcements/2026/filestore-sunset/). Manage a file in an existing Catalyst File Store folder (maximum 100 MB). Requires `ZohoCatalyst.files.CREATE`, `ZohoCatalyst.files.READ`, `ZohoCatalyst.files.DELETE`, project read access and `ZohoCatalyst.folders.READ`. Files are immutable through the documented API: changing any input replaces the file and changes its ID. Every refresh downloads the file to verify its SHA-256; file contents are never stored in Terraform state. Folder creation is not supported. Catalyst recommends Stratus for new storage; this resource supports existing File Store workloads. Import with `project_id/folder_id/file_id`, then set `source` and `source_sha256` in configuration. Deletion is polled for up to two minutes. This provider does not delete folders or other files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The folder must already exist. All local source bytes are checked at apply.
resource "catalyst_filestore_file" "example" {
  project_id    = var.project_id
  folder_id     = var.folder_id
  name          = "settings.json"
  source        = "${path.module}/settings.json"
  source_sha256 = filesha256("${path.module}/settings.json")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder_id` (String) Existing File Store folder's positive numeric ID.
- `name` (String) Remote file name, including extension, without directory separators.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID.
- `source` (String) Path to a local regular file available when Terraform applies. Use a path relative to the root module or an absolute path. The path is stored in state; file contents are not.
- `source_sha256` (String) Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the desired contents. Set to `filesha256(...)` for the source path. Apply verifies the local contents match this hash before uploading. Refresh records the remote hash so content drift plans replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) File ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `size` (Number) Remote file size in bytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace all three IDs with the project, folder and file you intend to manage.
terraform import catalyst_filestore_file.example 'PROJECT_ID/FOLDER_ID/FILE_ID'
```
